evidence.origin: Conceptual full-unit arrangement for the exact four-loop executable PWR, authored 25 October 2026. Accepted turbine geometry retained; system/building relationships follow generic nuclear-plant references. The containment uses 32 closed, ordinary wall facets with real personnel/hatch voids, approximating its ellipse within 0.56m. Civil dimensions, access, nozzle positions and routing remain authored illustration, not surveyed, as-built, maintenance or safety qualification. Connected-layout revision authored 27 October 2026 retires explicitly superseded unbound utility preview paths; the complete accepted graph/terminal routing network, bound headers and turbine subassembly remain unchanged.
